question: Who said 'PURA is one of the mechanisms which will be utilised for transforming our villages into productive economic zones'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PURA**:-

 
 
• It stands for Providing Urban Amenities in Rural Areas.
 
• It is a scheme launched by the Government of India to provide basic infrastructure and amenities in rural areas to improve the standard of living of the rural population.
 
• The scheme aims to create productive economic zones in rural areas by providing basic infrastructure and amenities like electricity, water supply, roads, sanitation, healthcare, education, and skill development. 
 
• APJ Abdul Kalam said 'PURA is one of the mechanisms which will be utilised for t
ransforming our villages into productive economic zones'.
